translations.Sobald Sie zu einem Projekt gehören, ste: As soon as you belong to a project, it will appear here.

translations.Auch die Kundenseite sieht diesen Vorgan: The customer side sees this item too
translations.Nur meine Seite des Projekts: Only my side of the project
translations.ProjektWerk ist für Gastkonten nicht fre: ProjektWerk is not enabled for guest accounts. An administrator has to add the app to the allow list of the Guests app.
translations.Auf „Nur ich\" herunterstufen kann nur d: Only the person who created it can restrict it to “Only me”
translations.Der Vorgang wurde zwischenzeitlich geänd: The item has changed in the meantime. Please reload.
The item has changed in the meantime. The view has been reloaded.
translations.Dieser Vorgang steht Ihnen nicht zur Ver: This item is not available to you. Ask the project lead if you expected to see it.
translations.Projekteinstellungen pflegen interne Mit: Project settings are maintained by internal members with management rights.
translations.Leer lassen blendet den Knopf „Zum Proje: Leaving this empty hides the “Go to project chat” button.
translations.Personenweise, keine Gruppen — die Rolle: Person by person, no groups — the role belongs to the membership, not to the Nextcloud account.
translations.Ein archiviertes Projekt bleibt lesbar u: An archived project stays readable and disappears from the project list.
translations.Verwaltungsrecht konnte nicht geändert w: Could not change the management right
translations.Fälligkeit konnte nicht gesetzt werden: Could not set the due date
translations.Arbeitsschritt konnte nicht angelegt wer: Could not create the work step
translations.Dieser Kommentar wird endgültig entfernt: This comment will be removed for good. There is no trash bin.
translations.Alle Vorgänge wandern in die gewählte Sp: All items move to the chosen column, then “{from}” is removed.
translations.Alle Vorgänge wandern nach „{to}“, danac: All items move to “{to}”, then “{from}” is removed.
%n of them is visible to you.
%n of them are visible to you.
translations.Verborgene Vorgänge wandern mit, ohne hi: Hidden items move along without appearing here. Nothing is lost.
translations.Sobald Ihnen ein Arbeitsschritt zugewies: As soon as a work step is assigned to you or you are responsible for an item, it will appear here.
translations.Arbeitsschritt konnte nicht erledigt wer: Work step could not be completed
translations.Keine Verbindung zum Server. Bitte späte: No connection to the server. Please try again later.
translations.Gefunden werden nur bestehende Nextcloud: Only existing Nextcloud accounts are found. Anyone without one — on the client side, for instance — needs one first: the administration creates it, as a guest or a full account.
translations.Anhänge an Vorgängen landen in diesen Or: Attachments on tickets are stored in these folders. Without a folder, the tickets concerned cannot have attachments.
translations.Ordner für Vorgänge, die alle Beteiligte: Folder for tickets everyone involved can see
translations.Die Kundenseite hat Zugriff. Leer lassen: The customer side has access. Leaving it empty means these tickets cannot have attachments.
translations.Nur die eigene Seite hat Zugriff. Leer l: Only your own side has access. Leaving it empty means internal tickets cannot have attachments.
translations.Der Anhang „{name}“ wird vom Vorgang gel: The attachment “{name}” will be detached from this ticket.
translations.Die Datei selbst bleibt liegen, wo sie l: The file itself stays where it is — this app never deletes files.
_Dieser Vorgang hat %n Anhang. Bitte ihn: This ticket has %n attachment. Please detach it first — the file itself stays where it is.
This ticket has %n attachments. Please detach them first — the files themselves stay where they are.
translations.Die erste Zeile gilt für alle Projekte —: The first row applies to all projects — including those added later. Individual projects below can differ from it.
translations.Ein Arbeitsschritt wird mir zugewiesen: A step is assigned to me
translations.Ein Punkt am Kästchen heißt: für dieses: A dot next to a box means: set for this project. Without a dot, the first row applies.
translations.Ein Vorgang wird mir zugewiesen: A ticket is assigned to me
translations.Ein neuer Vorgang entsteht im Projekt: A new ticket is created in the project
translations.Wie möchten Sie benachrichtigt werden?: How would you like to be notified?
translations.Wovon möchten Sie benachrichtigt werden?: What would you like to be notified about?
Nothing is waiting for you right now.
translations.Zuweisen oder Frist setzen: Assign or set a due date
translations.Jemand kommentiert einen Vorgang, an dem: Someone comments on a ticket I am involved in
translations.Ein Vorgang, an dem ich beteiligt bin, w: A ticket I am involved in is closed
translations.Ihnen wurde ein Vorgang zugewiesen: #%1$: A ticket has been assigned to you: #%1$s %2$s
translations.Ihnen wurde ein Arbeitsschritt zugewiese: A work step has been assigned to you: #%1$s %2$s
translations.Vorgang #%1$s wurde Ihnen zugewiesen: Ticket #%1$s has been assigned to you
translations.Arbeitsschritt in Vorgang #%1$s wurde Ih: A work step in ticket #%1$s has been assigned to you
translations.Die Guests-App ist nicht im Einsatz — fü: The Guests app is not in use — there is nothing to set up for ProjektWerk.
translations.Die Freigabeliste der Guests-App ist abg: The Guests app allow list is switched off; guests can reach every app.
translations.ProjektWerk und der Viewer stehen auf de: ProjektWerk and the Viewer are on the Guests app allow list.
translations.ProjektWerk fehlt auf der Freigabeliste: ProjektWerk is missing from the Guests app allow list. Every request a guest makes to this app is rejected — including API calls, which then receive an HTML error page instead of data. The app is unusable for customers.
translations.Der Viewer fehlt auf der Freigabeliste d: The Viewer is missing from the Guests app allow list. Guests cannot open attachments; everything else works.
translations.Fehlend: %1$s\\nDie bestehende Liste zue:
Missing: %1$s
Read the existing list first and write it back extended — setting it blindly replaces the built-in default of the Guests app and takes twelve apps away from guests. The full target value is:

occ config:app:set guests whitelist --value="%2$s"
translations.Hintergrundaufträge, Basis-URL und SMTP-: Background jobs, base URL and SMTP timeout are suitable for ProjektWerk.
translations.Hintergrundaufträge laufen im Modus „%s\: Background jobs run in "%s" mode instead of "cron". ProjektWerk sends notifications from a scheduled job. In "ajax" mode that job only runs when someone opens a page of this instance — but the recipients are mostly customers, who rarely do. Switch with: occ background:cron
"overwrite.cli.url" is not set. Links in emails to customers are built from this value and would be unusable. Set it in config.php to the address reachable from outside.
translations.„overwrite.cli.url\" zeigt auf „%s\". Li: "overwrite.cli.url" points to "%s". Links in emails to customers are built from this value and therefore lead nowhere — sending and delivery still report success. Set it in config.php to the address reachable from outside.
translations.„mail_smtptimeout\" steht auf %1$s Sekun: "mail_smtptimeout" is set to %1$s seconds (without an entry Nextcloud's default of 10 applies). If the mail server does not answer, that time hangs in the save operation of whoever is creating a ticket right now. %2$s seconds is measured to work.
translations.Der Überblick konnte nicht geladen werde: The overview could not be loaded
translations.Hier steht, was bei der Kundenseite lieg: This is where you see what is sitting with the client side and which projects have activity. As long as every ticket is done, the page stays empty.
translations.Legen Sie Ihr erstes Projekt an, oder wa: Create your first project, or wait until you are added to one.
The folders could not be loaded.
The folder could not be created.
translations.Keine privaten Vorgänge dieser Person we: None of this person's private tickets will be deleted. Internal and public tickets stay with the project.
translations.{name} aus dem Projekt entfernen? Offene: Remove {name} from the project? This person's open assignments will be cleared.
translations.Die Vorschau konnte nicht geladen werden: The preview could not be loaded
translations.Mitglied konnte nicht entfernt werden: The member could not be removed
_Dabei wird %n privater Vorgang dieser P: This will permanently delete %n private ticket of this person.
This will permanently delete %n private tickets of this person.
translations.Die beiden Seiten des Projekts. Beides i: The two sides of the project. Both are optional and can be changed at any time.
translations.Ein Gastkonto entsteht, wenn du in „Date: A guest account is created when you share a folder with the person’s email address in “Files”.
translations.Diese Spalten wurden angelegt. Anpassen,: These columns were created. You can adjust, rename or add to them at any time in the project settings.
translations.Dateien an „Nur ich\"-Vorgängen liegen i: Files on "Only me" items live in this folder in your own files. Without a choice, "ProjektWerk" is used and created on the first attachment.
translations.Der Ordner für private Anhänge konnte ni: The folder for private attachments could not be loaded
translations.Neuen Token eingeben, um den vorhandenen: Enter a new token to replace the existing one
translations.Der GitHub-Token-Status konnte nicht gel: The GitHub token status could not be loaded
translations.Zum Überführen von Vorgängen nach GitHub: For transferring items to GitHub. Recommended: a fine-grained token (PAT) with the “Issues: read and write” permission on the target repositories. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
translations.Im Format „owner/repo“, z. B. „cpcMoment: In the format “owner/repo”, e.g. “cpcMomentum/projektwerk”. Typing searches your GitHub repositories — this requires a token stored in “My settings”. Leaving it empty keeps the transfer hidden until a target is entered.
translations.Ihnen wurde der Vorgang #%1$s „%2$s“ zug: Ticket #%1$s “%2$s” has been assigned to you.
translations.Ihnen wurde ein Arbeitsschritt im Vorgan: A work step in ticket #%1$s “%2$s” has been assigned to you.
translations.Es gibt einen neuen Kommentar zum Vorgan: There is a new comment on ticket #%1$s “%2$s”.
translations.Im Projekt ist der neue Vorgang #%1$s „%: A new ticket #%1$s “%2$s” has been created in the project.
